summary: Charging Robotics Inc., via its wholly owned subsidiary Charging Israel, entered a share purchase agreement on August 31, 2026, selling 149 ordinary shares (51% of Charging Israel) to Clearmind Medicine Inc. for $2.5 million ($16,778/share). Post-closing, Charging retains 49%. Concurrently, Clearmind extended a $1.5 million loan to Charging Israel at 4% interest, maturing in three years, extendable until positive cash flow. Both transactions close around September 7, 2026, subject to customary conditions. Watch regulatory approval and the retained minority stake's governance rights; risk-arb focuses on closing timing and loan extension triggers.
